2024 McLaren 750S Spider MSO Bespoke

An exceptional example of the 2024 McLaren 750S Spider, this highly specified supercar showcases an extraordinary level of McLaren Special Operations (MSO) personalization. Originally configured with an MSRP of $345,000, this 750S Spider carries approximately $182,889 in factory options, resulting in an original window sticker of approximately $527,889.

Finished in MSO Bespoke Black, this 750S Spider is complemented by an extensive collection of exposed and gloss carbon-fibre components, bespoke exterior details, and a beautifully appointed Alcantara interior.

The specification begins with the Vortex 5 Twin-Spoke Ultra-Lightweight wheels in Gloss Black Diamond Cut, complemented by MSO Bespoke brake calipers and bespoke wheel center caps. Carbon-fibre upgrades are extensive, including the Gloss Visual Carbon Fibre hood, active rear spoiler, front fenders and louvres, carbon-fibre seat backs, extended satin carbon-fibre sill trim, and carbon-fibre interior package.

Power-adjustable heated memory seats provide comfort without compromising the car's unmistakably performance-focused character.

Technology and convenience are equally impressive, with Bowers & Wilkins 12-speaker premium audio, 360-degree Park Assist, HomeLink, and additional factory equipment.

The exterior is where this 750S Spider truly distinguishes itself. The extensive MSO Bespoke specification includes bespoke paint, rear spoiler, hood detailing, pinstripe package, electroform badging, wheel center caps, front-fender louvres, and numerous individually specified carbon-fibre and interior details. Even the smallest elementsfrom the key shells to the steering-wheel claspwere personalized through MSO.

The Porsche 911 Carrera 4S represents the pinnacle of all-weather performance, merging timeless design with engineering precision. Powered by a twin-turbocharged flat-six engine, this model delivers breath-taking acceleration while maintaining remarkable balance and composure across all driving conditions.

Performance and handling are elevated through the Porsche Doppelkupplung dual-clutch transmission, which executes instantaneous gear shifts without interrupting power delivery. Paired with an intelligent all-wheel-drive system, power is dynamically distributed between the front and rear axles to maximize traction, cornering grip, and high-speed stability. The addition of the Sport Chrono Package unlocks the vehicle's full performance potential, introducing launch control, dynamic engine mounts, and selectable drive modes that instantly sharpen throttle response, steering feedback, and gearshift timing. The auditory experience is heightened by the factory Sport Exhaust System, which features active exhaust flaps that open at the touch of a button to unleash a deeper, more pronounced flat-six engine note.

Design and luxury seamlessly merge within the driver-centric cabin, anchored by Power Sport Seats that provide comprehensive multi-way adjustment and memory settings for tailored support. On warmer days, integrated seat ventilation actively circulates air through the perforated leather to ensure lasting comfort during long drives. The overall interior environment is further enhanced by the Premium Package, which integrates key luxury and convenience features designed to simplify daily driving and elevate cabin refinement.

Technology and safety features focus on effortless operation and driver confidence. Advanced exterior lighting improves night-time visibility around corners, while integrated parking sensors and assist systems help make maneuvering in tight spaces completely stress-free. Surrounding drivers with high-fidelity sound, the Bose Surround Sound System utilizes acoustic equalization specifically tuned to the 911 interior, delivering crystal-clear sound quality and rich bass that easily overcomes road and wind noise.

Convenience and comfort are prioritized throughout every detail of the cabin, offering intuitive control placement, dual-zone automatic climate control, and generous storage spaces for maximum everyday usability. Whether navigating tight city streets, commuting long distances, or exploring winding roads, this Carrera 4S offers an exceptional balance of sports car agility and grand touring luxury.

Certified Pre-Owned 2025 Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC+ Cabriolet Only 1,661 Miles

MANUFAKTUR Starling Blue Magno | Pinnacle Trim | Driver Assistance Package | AMG Carbon Fiber Trim

Experience open-air luxury and exhilarating AMG performance in this Certified Pre-Owned 2025 Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC+ Cabriolet with just 1,661 miles. Finished in striking MANUFAKTUR Starling Blue Magno over Macchiato Beige/Black leather, this exceptionally low-mileage luxury convertible combines distinctive style, advanced technology, and confident all-wheel-drive capability.

An AMG-enhanced 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six engine with an electric auxiliary compressor and EQ Boost 48V mild-hybrid system delivers 443 horsepower. The AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT nine-speed automatic transmission, AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive, and active rear-axle steering bring responsive performance to every drive. Switchable Engine Sound adds another dimension to the AMG experience, while 20-inch AMG Multispoke Y-Design Wheels with Black Accents and summer tires complete the athletic appearance. Fuel economy is rated at 19 MPG city and 26 MPG highway.

Pinnacle Trim enhances the cabin with a Head-Up Display, Augmented Video for Navigation, and DIGITAL LIGHT with projection functionality. The Premium Package with Digital Extras, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and HD Radio provide convenient connectivity and entertainment. Digital features are subject to activation and applicable service terms.

The Driver Assistance Package includes Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC with Active Steering Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, evasive maneuver support, PRE-SAFE Impulse Side, Traffic Sign Assist, and Active Speed Limit Assist. Active Lane Change Assist, Extended Restart in Stop-and-Go Traffic, and Route-Based Speed Action further support a relaxed driving experience.

Inside, AMG Carbon Fiber Trim complements the leather upholstery, while ventilated front seats, the Winter Package, and a heated steering wheel enhance comfort. AIRSCARF neck-level heating and AIRCAP help extend your enjoyment of top-down driving. Additional equipment includes power-folding mirrors, auto-dimming driver and rearview mirrors, side mirror logo projectors, rear side airbags, an automatic trunk divider, a remote key with panic function, all-season front and rear black rubber floor mats, a TIREFIT kit, and a first-aid kit.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. In an automotive landscape dominated by the SUV and all of its various subdivisions, the two-door coupe feels like an endangered species. Key tech features also filter down one trim level, with lane keeping assist and a surround-view camera now standard on the Premium Plus, for example. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics

description:
This one is for the buyer who wants the Mustang experience without having to live with a V8 every day. This 2019 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium Convertible is a local trade with 53,129 miles, finished in Magnetic, and it has been fully serviced by factory trained technicians with service records available.

The 2.3L EcoBoost gives this Mustang plenty of punch, while the 10 speed automatic keeps it quick, smooth, and easy to drive around town or on the highway. A 3.15 limited slip rear axle helps put the power down, and of course the power convertible top lets you completely change the car whenever the weather cooperates.

Being a Premium model means the interior is much more than just a place to sit. You get leather bucket seats with color accents, heated and cooled front seats, a heated steering wheel, power driver and passenger seats, dual zone automatic climate control, remote start, and a garage door transmitter.

Equipment Group 201A and the Ford Safe and Smart Package bring a strong list of technology including Adaptive Cruise Control, Blind Spot Information System with Cross Traffic Alert, Lane Keeping Alert, Pre Collision Assist with Pedestrian Detection, automatic high beams, and rain sensing windshield wipers.

SYNC 3 handles the infotainment side with Voice Activated Touchscreen Navigation, SiriusXM, FordPass Connect, steering wheel controls, 911 Assist, and a rear backup camera.

The Wheel and Stripe Package gives it a little extra attitude with 19 inch machined face aluminum wheels, while the Magnetic paint keeps the overall look clean and understated.

There is a lot to like here if you want something fun that can still handle normal everyday life. Local trade, 53,129 miles, convertible top, EcoBoost power, heated and cooled leather, heated steering wheel, navigation, Adaptive Cruise, Blind Spot Monitoring, remote start, and 19 inch wheels.

We are a hometown family owned and operated dealership, and cars like this are why the used lot should still be fun to walk. Put the top down, take the long way home, and enjoy a Mustang that gives you plenty of performance without feeling like a chore to own every day.

This 2019 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF Grand Touring is presented as a compact rear-wheel-drive roadster with a retractable fastback roof and a two-seat cabin. The Grand Touring trim places the car near the upper end of the MX-5 RF line, and the included GT-S Package adds equipment that is listed with the vehicle. Its size, seating arrangement, and roof design give it a straightforward focus on open-air driving without adding unnecessary mass or complexity. The body uses Mazda's RF hardtop architecture rather than a conventional soft top, and the roof panels fold in a way that preserves the car's coupe-like profile when closed.

Inside, this example includes leather seats and the other equipment expected from the Grand Touring grade. The seating surfaces are finished in leather, and the cabin uses a simple two-place layout with controls arranged around the driver. Mazda's interior design for this model is compact and functional, with a low seating position and a dashboard that keeps major controls within reach. The materials and trim associated with this version are meant to be more refined than the base car without changing the MX-5's compact footprint. Storage space is limited in the way one would expect from a small two-seat sports car, and the interior remains centered on the occupants rather than on excess room or added seating.

This vehicle also includes navigation and premium audio. Those features add convenience and in-car functionality without changing the car's core purpose or driving character. The infotainment system is integrated into the center stack, where Mazda places the primary screen and command controls used across this model line. The available audio hardware is listed as premium, and it is part of the equipment set on this example. The interface is straightforward, with display and control elements positioned for regular use during city driving or longer trips. The RF body style also gives the cabin a more enclosed feel when the roof is in place compared with an open soft-top variant, while still allowing the car to be driven with the roof retracted when conditions permit.

Driver-assistance items listed on this example include collision warning, lane departure warning, and cross traffic alert. These systems are part of the car's electronic equipment and add another layer of monitoring to the driving experience. The MX-5 platform remains compact and light by modern standards, and its controls are sized accordingly, with steering, pedals, and the shifter placed for direct engagement from the driver's seat. The GT-S Package is included as well, and it adds to the vehicle's equipment list alongside the Grand Touring trim content. This 2019 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF Grand Touring therefore combines the RF roof design, leather-appointed interior, navigation, premium audio, and the stated warning systems in a small two-seat package with a clear emphasis on driver involvement and usable daily equipment.

description:
This 2014 BMW 4 Series 435i is a two-door luxury coupe with a focus on roadgoing performance and a restrained cabin presentation. It carries the 435i designation, which places it near the upper end of the 4 Series lineup for this model year. Its bodywork follows BMW's coupe proportions with a low roofline, a long hood, and short overhangs, and the details are kept relatively simple. This vehicle is described with Leather Seats, and that material gives the interior a more finished appearance than standard cloth trim.

This 2014 BMW 4 Series 435i is powered by BMW's turbocharged inline six-cylinder engine, which is paired with an automatic transmission. The drivetrain delivers smooth power delivery and strong pull at a wide range of speeds, which is consistent with the model's placement in the lineup. Steering and chassis tuning in this series are oriented toward balanced handling rather than softness alone, and the coupe format supports that character. This vehicle includes Push Start, so the ignition is operated without a traditional key turn.

This 2014 BMW 4 Series 435i is equipped with Xenon Headlights, which were offered on many premium vehicles of this period and provide a more advanced lighting system than basic halogen units. It also has Rain Sensing Wipers, which allow the wiper system to respond automatically to changing moisture on the windshield. These items are part of the car's exterior equipment and add convenience without changing the basic design of the vehicle. The front and rear body lines remain clean and controlled, with proportions that are consistent with BMW's coupe styling from the mid-2010s.

This 2014 BMW 4 Series 435i includes Automatic Climate Control, which manages cabin temperature through a set regulation system rather than a manual-only adjustment. It also has Bluetooth, giving the audio and communications system wireless connectivity for compatible devices. Inside, the driver-focused dashboard layout keeps primary controls within easy reach, and the seating position is low in relation to the road. The materials and switchgear reflect the class of the car, and the equipment list shown here is limited to the features noted above.
